$comment: Every secret this system uses, by name. Names and purposes only: a value never goes in this file, in the repo or in chat. Keep a copy of each value in a password manager, in one item (for example 'Home Dashboard') with one field per name below.
naming: <MODULE>_<WHAT>_<KIND>, upper case. KIND is one of KEY, TOKEN, PASSWORD, PASSPHRASE, ID.

createdBy.user: The person creates it by hand and stores it.
createdBy.agent: The setup agent creates it through the Cloudflare API and tells the person to store it.
createdBy.key-page: Generated in the admin's browser on the one-time /setup/keys page. The AI never sees it.

secrets.name: SETUP_CLOUDFLARE_FULL_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Full-access Cloudflare API token the agent uses during setup only. Must expire within 7 days.
secrets.livesIn: Environment secret of the AI doing the setup
secrets.rotate: Not rotated: deleted at the end of setup.
secrets.ifLost: Create a new 7-day token and run setup again; every step is safe to repeat.

secrets.name: DEPLOY_CLOUDFLARE_BUILD_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Lets Cloudflare Workers Builds deploy the Workers and apply database migrations on a merge to main.
secrets.rotate: Create a new token with the same permissions, select it in Workers Builds, delete the old one.
secrets.ifLost: Deploys stop until a new token is selected. No data is affected.

secrets.name: DEBUG_CLOUDFLARE_READONLY_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Read-only token so the AI can read build results and Worker logs when something breaks.
secrets.rotate: Create a new read-only token, replace the environment secret, delete the old one.
secrets.ifLost: The AI cannot read logs until replaced. Nothing else breaks.

secrets.name: SHELL_COMMAND_SIGNING_KEY
secrets.purpose: Signs every command the dashboard sends to an edge agent, so agents only obey this dashboard.
secrets.rotate: Generate a new key on the key page, then enrol each edge agent again.
secrets.ifLost: Edge agents refuse commands until re-enrolled. No data is lost.

secrets.name: BRAIN_SENSITIVE_ENCRYPTION_KEY
secrets.purpose: Encrypts notes in the Brain's sensitive tier.
secrets.rotate: Not supported yet: changing it needs a re-encryption run.
secrets.ifLost: Sensitive notes can never be read again.

secrets.name: FINANCE_DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY
secrets.rotate: Not supported yet: changing it needs a re-encryption run.
secrets.ifLost: Finance records can never be read again.

secrets.name: HEALTH_DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY
secrets.rotate: Not supported yet: changing it needs a re-encryption run.
secrets.ifLost: Health records can never be read again.

secrets.name: EXPORT_ZIP_PASSPHRASE
secrets.purpose: Opens the encrypted zip that Settings > Data export produces.
secrets.rotate: Set a new one on the key page. Old zips keep their old passphrase.
secrets.ifLost: Existing export zips cannot be opened. Live data is unaffected.

secrets.name: CALENDAR_ICLOUD_USER_ID
secrets.purpose: The Apple ID whose calendars are shown.
secrets.rotate: Set the new value on the Worker.
secrets.ifLost: Calendars stop loading until set again.

secrets.name: CALENDAR_ICLOUD_APP_PASSWORD
secrets.purpose: iCloud app-specific password for calendar access. Never the Apple ID's main password.
secrets.rotate: Revoke it at account.apple.com, create a new app-specific password, set it on the Worker.
secrets.ifLost: Calendars stop loading until a new one is set.

secrets.name: HA_API_LONGLIVED_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Home Assistant long-lived access token of a dedicated dashboard user.
secrets.rotate: Delete the token in Home Assistant, create a new one, set it on the Worker.
secrets.ifLost: Home controls and energy stop until a new one is set.

secrets.name: HA_TUNNEL_SERVICE_TOKEN_ID
secrets.purpose: Client id of the Cloudflare Access service token that lets only the dashboard reach the Home Assistant tunnel.
secrets.rotate: Rotate the service token in Cloudflare Access and set both parts again.
secrets.ifLost: Home controls and energy stop until a new one is set.

secrets.name: HA_TUNNEL_SERVICE_TOKEN_KEY
secrets.purpose: Client secret of the same service token.
secrets.ifLost: Home controls and energy stop until a new one is set.

secrets.name: AGENT_<MACHINE>_SERVICE_TOKEN_ID
secrets.purpose: Client id of one machine's Cloudflare Access service token. One pair per machine; <MACHINE> is its id in upper case.
secrets.rotate: Create a new service token for the machine and enrol it again.
secrets.ifLost: That machine stops reporting until re-enrolled.

secrets.name: AGENT_<MACHINE>_SERVICE_TOKEN_KEY
secrets.purpose: Client secret of the same service token.
secrets.ifLost: That machine stops reporting until re-enrolled.

secrets.name: ALFRED_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.purpose: Claude API key for the in-dashboard assistant. Usage is billed by Anthropic.
secrets.rotate: Create a new key in the Anthropic console, set it on the Worker, delete the old key.
secrets.ifLost: Alfred stops answering until a new key is set.

secrets.name: ALFRED_GATEWAY_KEY
secrets.purpose: Alfred's own key for the MCP gateway. Only its hash is stored in the gateway's database.
secrets.rotate: Create a new gateway key named alfred, set it on the Worker; the old hash is revoked.
secrets.ifLost: Alfred loses its tools until a new key is set.
